verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows the general idea of the story. Temporal models business logic as ordinary workflow code with side effects in Activities (temporal-comm-1, temporal-docs-3), and replaces hand-rolled queues, state tables and reconciliation jobs (temporal-docs-46). A user also reports that it distributes work across machines without much orchestration effort (temporal-comm-7). Nothing in the pack documents the specific composition primitives the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented parallel Activity execution, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, child workflows, and hands-on corroboration of these patterns.
